// Generated from changelog/changelog.json by GenerateChangelogMain — do not edit.

The classic Wicket user interface is gone: the last pages were migrated to projectforge-next and the module projectforge-wicket was deleted.

__Snapshot build https://github.com/micromata/projectforge/commit/203115800[develop@203115800], https://github.com/micromata/projectforge/compare/e944881b0..203115800[changes since e944881b0].__

++++
{% include tag.html tag="added" %}
++++
- **Problem dashboard**
  * Log events are classified at the call site and aggregated in the database with a persistent problem status.
  * Dashboard of all problems, with links into the log viewer and an export as JSON for an AI-assisted analysis.
  * Prioritized error digest mails per audience (HTML, new design) instead of one mail per error; early digest for new security and data problems.
  * Error figures in the system statistics.
- Order statistics page with its own filter, favorites, charts, data tables, budget scenario and warnings about lost budgets.
- Invoicing quota as a tab in __My statistics__.
- Gateway: delta sync with a nightly full sync including deletions and CardDAV favorites, public heartbeat, data transfer UI after OAuth2 login.
- Kost2: shared cost flag, overriding the structure element (also in the mass update).
- ICS import of team events with a diff preview; download of a team event as ics file; shared subscription dialog for time sheets, holidays and weeks of year.
- Run several development instances side by side (`+bin/pfDev.sh+` slots).

++++
{% include tag.html tag="improved" %}
++++
- **Migrated to projectforge-next**
  * DATEV import with view log button, readable import log and account/cost unit tooltips.
  * Log viewer, HR planning, HR view, Gantt charts, report objectives, to-dos, IHK plugin and the internal data transfer UI (area page as tabs, files as a sortable table).
  * Calendar and team calendar pages, cost 1/2 Excel export; the remaining gaps against the Wicket pages were closed before their removal.
- Configurable customer groups and business units; time sheets, invoices, projects and orders can be filtered by business unit, customer and project (checklist filters).
- Order book: contribution margin tab including the year before last.
- Mass update for to-dos and for the payment type of salaries.
- Calendar subscriptions that keep failing are retried less often and deactivated after 90 days.
- Timeouts, connection pools and sync statistics for LDAP, identity provider, iCal, SMS and Sipgate clients.
- The browser window is named after the page; the open tab of list and report pages is kept in the URL.
- Shift+click selects a range in attachment lists.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="fixed" %}
++++
- Subscribed calendars: DTSTAMP no longer breaks parsing; events without DTEND derive their end from DURATION; one event per holiday and week in the feeds.
- MS Project export of Gantt charts repaired (mpxj upgraded).
- Kotlin script classes are resolved in the fat jar again.
- Password reset button, birthday mail locale and inline logo in mails.
- The JCR sanity check runs only once per night.
- Expected client and authentication failures are logged below error level.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="security" %}
++++
- Access checks for all new REST endpoints, enforced by an architecture test.
- npm security advisories in next and webapp patched.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="removed" %}
++++
- Module projectforge-wicket including all Wicket pages, about 90 Wicket-only i18n keys and libraries no longer used.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="technology" %}
++++
- Spring Boot 4.1, Spring 7, Hibernate 7.4, Hibernate Search 8.4, Tomcat 11 (via Spring Boot 3.5 as intermediate step).
- Kotlin 2.3, JUnit 6, Gradle 9.8, kotlin-logging 7.
